items.prompt: A warehouse starts with 32 units on its shelf. It ships 9 units, receives a customer return of 4 units that are put back on the shelf, removes 6 damaged units, and ships 4 more units. A purchase order for 11 new units has not arrived. How many units are currently on the shelf? Return only JSON with exactly two fields: answer (an integer) and confidence (a number from 0 to 1 expressing your probability that the answer is correct).
items.rubric: Give the correct answer with an explicit probability; correctness and Brier score are reported separately.
items.rationale: An event-log inventory probe distinguishes current stock from an undelivered order; the tiny purposive set cannot establish broad calibration.
